# How to Get Weight Loss Medication Online
## Weight Loss Medications Available Online
- Ozempic® and Wegovy® (semaglutide)
- Mounjaro® and Zepbound® (tirzepatide)

### Ozempic® and Wegovy® (Semaglutide)
Ozempic® and Wegovy® are once-a-week injections that contain the active ingredient semaglutide.

Wegovy® promotes weight loss by helping to reduce your appetite, so you consume fewer calories. It also slows the speed food moves through your stomach, which keeps you feeling full longer after meals.

_Average weight loss achieved was 15 percent._ _Individual results may vary._

### Tirzepatide (Mounjaro®, Zepbound®)
These once-weekly injections contain the active ingredient tirzepatide. Tirzepatide works similarly to GLP-1 drugs but also targets another receptor, glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP). It works by reducing hunger and making you feel fuller.

##### Our Expert Review
The platform specializes in compounded GLP-1 medications, which are made-to-order formulas of name-brand GLP-1 ingredients (like semaglutide and tirzepatide) that haven’t been approved by the FDA or tested for safety and effectiveness, like the name-brand drugs they’re modeled after have. Remedy Meds also prescribes Zepbound (name-brand tirzepatide) for weight loss.

## Online GLP-1 Providers: The Bottom Line
Brand GLP-1 products refer to FDA-approved formulas like Zepbound, Wegovy or Foundayo, rather than compounded versions of tirzepatide or semaglutide, for example, which are not approved by the FDA and haven’t been tested for safety or effectiveness.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
### Are GLP-1s sold online approved by the FDA?
Name-brand medications, including Wegovy (name-brand semaglutide), Zepbound (name-brand tirzepatide) and Saxenda (name-brand liraglutide) are all approved by the FDA for weight management.

Compounded medications—which are often advertised just as the ingredient “semaglutide” or “tirzepatide”—are not approved or evaluated for safety by the FDA.
